title: Bug Sprint 2D
description: Race across colorful garden leaves and forest branches as a speedy little beetle—leap pitfalls, dodge hungry predators, and blast through side-scrolling courses.
controls: Tap jump and action controls to leap over gaps, bounce off springs, and sprint to the finish line.

zh-CN.title: 虫虫快跑
zh-CN.description: 精致横版卡通跑酷虫虫快跑：化身敏捷小甲虫在微观花园赛道极速冲刺，灵活二段跳越过沟壑与天敌冲向终点！
zh-CN.controls: 点击屏幕跳跃与冲刺按钮越过障碍沟壑，收集奖励冲刺终点。
